name: create_work_notification
description: Notify the OWNER one-way about a work-object node (a UI notification, NO reply, never blocks). Given a work_id + node_id, it pulls the node's intent plus its upstream results off the graph and phrases a warm heads-up. This is how a work object's `notify` node reaches the owner — use it instead of send_email for the owner.

inputs.name: node_id
inputs.description: The notify node id within that work object (its content is the message intent; its upstream nodes' results are folded in).
